name: Tsoabichi
sum: Basal caiman from the early Eocene Green River Formation of Wyoming, close to the living dwarf caimans.
holotype: Type material of T. greenriverensis from the Green River Formation, Wyoming (Brochu 2010).
material: Specimens from the Green River Formation.
biology: Probably descends from caimans that dispersed into North America from South America; its back osteoderms are wider than in other caimans.
author: Brochu 2010
